query: I was out walking my golden retriever this morning and he chased a squirrel right into a patch of dandelions, rolled around so much his fur is full of fluffy yellow seeds I’ve been picking out for an hour now. On the way home I popped into that new bubble tea shop on the corner, got a taro milk tea with boba, and it was way sweeter than I expected, I think I’ll ask for half sugar next time. I also just remembered I need to pick up a new pack of rechargeable AA batteries for my TV remote later, the old ones died last night when I was in the middle of my favorite show. Anyways, my phone isn’t working at all right now, I can’t make or receive calls or use mobile data, I’m not sure if it’s because my line got suspended from an overdue bill and my contract ending, or if the SIM card just came unseated in the tray, can you help me figure this out?
